# Owner-runtime terminal closure

All five reviewed defects are confirmed at stable boundaries. The selected owner contract contains no machine-readable UnitBudget for any of the ten AVAILABLE owners, while the controller accepts caller-supplied values. Every named reconciler resolves to a fail-closed placeholder and STARTED effects are always made INDETERMINATE. Exit zero is terminalized without loading a semantic terminal contract; blocker re-entry can even exit zero when finalOk is false. Blocker re-entry is the sole non-standalone owner, but ActionIntent and dispatch carry no active-parent proof and both named parents currently require custodian evidence. Parameter validation uses hardcoded adapter tables rather than the selected schema, and paths have no per-parameter trusted-root binding, traversal rejection, or resolved containment proof.

The stable boundary is fail-closed materialization. An owner may execute only when its content-addressed contract supplies: a complete authoritative UnitBudget; an implemented typed reconciler with effect-bound observables; an executable semantic terminal verifier; valid parent delegation when non-standalone; and a complete parameter schema with per-path root bindings. No numeric budget, effect result, terminal marker, parent context, or path root may be inferred from prose or identifiers. Existing deterministic observables make bootstrap and promotion the strongest reconciliation candidates, but no current prevention reconciler invokes them. Owners lacking finite custodian inputs remain non-executable rather than retaining an inaccurate AVAILABLE label.

evidence_index.supported_claim: Defines all ten frozen current/future requirements and acceptance boundaries.
The ten AVAILABLE rows contain prose budget, reconciliation, terminal, effect, and parameter descriptions but no numeric machine-readable UnitBudget.
evidence_index.limitations: Descriptive fields are not executable typed contracts.

evidence_index.supported_claim: Names owner contract symbols and shows blocker re-entry is non-standalone with exactly two parent IDs.
evidence_index.limitations: Contains no active-parent proof or per-path root assignment.

evidence_index.supported_claim: UnitBudget is numeric but permits empty mandatory roles and zero overheads and has no owner-derived producer.
evidence_index.limitations: Defines arithmetic, not authoritative per-owner values.

evidence_index.supported_claim: Accepts caller-supplied budgets, ignores standalone and parent metadata, and invokes the owner runtime after reservation.
evidence_index.limitations: Does not own semantic reconciliation or terminal parsing.

evidence_index.supported_claim: Persists effect identities but maps every STARTED effect to INDETERMINATE and every zero-exit EXECUTED effect to TERMINAL without semantic validation.
evidence_index.limitations: Does not invoke owner reconciler or terminal contract symbols.

evidence_index.supported_claim: Uses hardcoded parameter/path tables, passes paths unchanged, exposes blocker re-entry directly, and resolves every reconciler symbol to a fail-closed placeholder.
evidence_index.limitations: Does not consume owner schemas, roots, parent metadata, or terminal contracts.

evidence_index.supported_claim: ActionIntent has no parent context; PATH JSON rejects absolute input but not traversal or resolved escape, and direct dataclass construction bypasses JSON validation.
evidence_index.limitations: Materialized owner schema is not converted to executable ParameterSpec records.

evidence_index.supported_claim: Defines the three reconciliation outcomes and trusted-root containment helpers available for reuse.
evidence_index.limitations: Those helpers are not connected to owner runtime dispatch.

evidence_index.supported_claim: Re-entry emits verdict/finalOk/errorCode but returns zero unconditionally after non-dry execution.
evidence_index.limitations: Does not validate prevention parent context.

evidence_index.supported_claim: Implements deterministic artifact, bundle, receipt, run, event, and retry-recovery identities suitable for a typed reconciler.
evidence_index.limitations: The prevention runtime does not invoke that recovery logic.

evidence_index.supported_claim: Implements explicit lifecycle identities and terminal stages suitable for typed reconciliation and terminal verification.
evidence_index.limitations: No prevention reconciler or terminal verifier currently calls it.

verification_anchors: missing/incomplete contract budget rejects before prepare
required_inputs: Each implementation-source custodian supplies authoritative numeric complete-unit values and provenance; otherwise the owner remains fail closed.
PO-O1-BUDGET.owner: prevention owner-contract maintainer and named implementation-source custodian
PO-O1-BUDGET.closure_condition: Every executable owner content-addresses a complete UnitBudget and caller values are ignored/rejected.

verification_anchors: understatement, missing role, identity mismatch, exact-boundary, no-runner cases
required_inputs: Authoritative per-owner budget payloads from PO-O1-BUDGET.
PO-O1-BUDGET-ACCEPTANCE.closure_condition: All invalid budgets reject before effects and exact complete budgets admit once.

verification_anchors: STARTED invokes reconciler without handler and persists one outcome
required_inputs: Each owner custodian supplies a finite effect-bound observable contract; unbound owners remain INDETERMINATE.
PO-O2-RECONCILE.owner: prevention runtime maintainer and implementation-source custodian
PO-O2-RECONCILE.closure_condition: Every reconciler is content-addressed and never blindly reruns STARTED effects.

verification_anchors: red-before/green-after crash window; repeated resume; mismatch remains INDETERMINATE
required_inputs: Captured same-path states for each supported observable class.
PO-O2-RECONCILE-ACCEPTANCE.closure_condition: Supported owner classes reconcile without duplication; unsupported cases stop unresolved.

verification_anchors: zero exit plus false/missing evidence does not terminalize; valid evidence emits once
required_inputs: Each owner custodian materializes its command-specific terminal verifier; child terminal remains parent-owned.
PO-O3-TERMINAL.closure_condition: No owner terminalizes from exit code alone and exactly one semantic terminal record exists.

verification_anchors: malformed, false, absent marker, artifact mismatch, replay, and valid cases
required_inputs: Valid and invalid fixtures from each real owner output contract.
PO-O3-TERMINAL-ACCEPTANCE.closure_condition: Semantic failure and exactly-once success are proven for every executable owner class.

verification_anchors: direct child rejects before budget; valid active parent binds lifecycle identity
PO-O4-PARENT.closure_condition: Child executes only through an eligible active named parent and remains fail closed while both parents lack evidence.

verification_anchors: direct, forged, mismatched, stale, unavailable, and valid parent cases
PO-O4-PARENT-ACCEPTANCE.closure_condition: Every invalid delegation rejects before effects and valid delegation preserves parent identity.

verification_anchors: schema-exact validation and root-contained resolution before argv
required_inputs: Each custodian supplies a finite per-path root-key assignment; absent assignments keep the owner fail closed.
PO-O5-PARAMETERS.owner: prevention owner-contract/adapter maintainers and implementation-source custodian
PO-O5-PARAMETERS.closure_condition: Selected owner schema is authoritative and every path has a trusted root or rejects.

required_inputs: Canonical valid fixtures and per-path root binding table from owner evidence.
PO-O5-PARAMETERS-ACCEPTANCE.closure_condition: All invalid inputs fail before argv/effects and valid inputs match real parser argv.

research_value.stable_policy: all ten fail closed until authoritative complete-unit values are content-addressed

research_value.failure: missing, incomplete, overridden, mismatched, or insufficient rejects

research_value.rule: invoke typed reconciler without handler; persist evidence-bound outcome; only NOT_APPLIED may execute once

research_value.false_success_example: blocker re-entry can return zero with finalOk false
